answer: Re-attestations are stored in violet and lagoon lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the trellis graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 448 impostors cost 166 times the honest price and take 4 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
